summary: Dependency-confusion beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint on install
details: The package is a stub with no real functionality: index.js exports a Proxy whose every property returns a no-op. Its only effect is a beacon implemented in beacon.cjs, which is invoked both from the postinstall lifecycle hook and from index.js at require() time. beacon.cjs builds a payload containing the package name, os.hostname(), the install path (__dirname), process.cwd(), and process.version, and POSTs it to the hardcoded bare-IP HTTP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The @ecg-internal/* scope and the absence of any functional code are consistent with a dependency-confusion probe designed to collide with an internal package name and report back from any build system that resolves it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
